purpose: Full individual human QA of all 8 final-hygiene-test images, each compared against its documented original defect from Batch-1 and/or the prior remediation_test_12_v1 round.

results.prior_defect: remediation_test_12_v1: readable 'Product Roadmap' title + column headers 'Discover/Validate/Build/Launch/Optimize'.
results.outcome: FIXED - the round table diagram is now a rich, fully abstract hexagon/node network with colored bars; background whiteboard is abstract blocks/arrows; device mockups on shelves show blank wireframe placeholders, no logos. Zero readable text anywhere.

results.prior_defect: remediation_test_12_v1: readable 'Life Map' title on the primary planning sheet (prior 'FINANCE' book-spine and 'Mind Map' header were already fixed then).
results.text_leak_detail: No large title this time, but small legible sticky-note-style labels are visible on the corkboard, including 'Side Hustles' and what reads as 'Investing'. Location: corkboard, secondary/mid-ground. Severity: MODERATE (much smaller and less dominant than the prior 'Life Map' title, but still clearly readable words).
results.outcome: PARTIALLY FIXED - the title-specific pattern is gone, but small distributed readable labels persist on the board. Net improvement over both Batch-1 and the prior remediation round, but still fails the strict 0-readable-text requirement.

results.prior_defect: Batch-1 and remediation_test_12_v1 (both): the literal hobby name 'ZINE' rendered repeatedly and clearly on multiple zine/prop covers; 'COMICS' also readable on a shelf book.
results.text_leak_detail: The primary zine/booklet being actively made on the desk (the hero object) is now completely free of the 'ZINE' wordmark and any other readable text. However, the background wall poster/flyer collage still shows some legible-looking gig-poster-style text fragments. Location: background wall decor, secondary. Severity: MINOR-MODERATE (major improvement on the primary prop; residual leak is incidental environmental decor, not the craft object itself).
results.outcome: MAJOR IMPROVEMENT, NOT FULLY FIXED - the specific direct violation (hobby name on the hero prop) is eliminated; a secondary, lower-severity leak remains in background wall decor.

results.prior_defect: Batch-1 and remediation_test_12_v1 (both): whiteboard flowchart extensively readable; book cover clearly reads 'THESAURUS'; prior round additionally showed a full readable joke line.
results.text_leak_detail: 'THESAURUS' still clearly readable on the book spine, unchanged from both prior rounds. Notebook content is now illegible scribble marks (improved - no more full readable joke line). Location: foreground book prop, dominant. Severity: MODERATE (one persistent, unchanged violation; notebook improved).
results.outcome: PARTIALLY FIXED - notebook/script content improved to illegible, but the book-title prop violation is unchanged across all three rounds. Likely needs a hobby-level override targeting this specific prop, similar to the books.reading fix.

results.prior_defect: Batch-1: large, fully legible graffiti wall text - 'FLOW', 'CYPHER', 'UNITY EST. 98'.
results.brand_leak_detail: NEW finding this round (not present in the Batch-1 record for this id): a pale swoosh-like curved mark is visible on the black sneaker on the kicking foot, and the woman's orange jacket sleeve shows a clear three-stripe pattern resembling a real sportswear brand.
results.outcome: TEXT FULLY FIXED (graffiti wall is now completely non-linguistic tag-style scribbles), but a NEW brand/trademark issue was discovered in the same generation (footwear/apparel silhouette family, the same class of residual risk already documented for sports.skateboarding and arts.kpop_dance). Needs brand-safety review before regeneration.

results.prior_defect: Batch-1: script pages held by multiple actors show small but clearly legible Japanese text.
results.outcome: FIXED - script pages are now fully illegible dense line-texture; background monitors blank/dark; mixing console generic. Clean.

results.role: additional arts offender (workshop/scroll family, hardest stress test)
results.prior_defect: Batch-1: multiple background wall-scroll characters beyond the one semantically-necessary in-progress brushstroke.
results.text_leak_detail: Background hanging scroll and framed wall pieces still show large, legible-looking individual kanji-style characters, beyond the actively-written character on the main paper (which is semantically expected and not counted as a violation). Location: background wall decor, secondary but visually prominent. Severity: MODERATE, essentially unchanged from Batch-1.
results.outcome: NOT FIXED, LARGELY AS EXPECTED - this was deliberately chosen as the hardest possible stress test since the craft itself is about writing characters. The general arts_text_suppression_policy was not sufficient here; needs a hobby-level override (background wall art must be blank/abstract) similar to the existing wellness.tai_chi fix.

results.role: additional arts offender (layout/design surface + screen UI family)
results.prior_defect: Batch-1: tablet shows visible toolbar icon chrome (screen-policy leak); comic book cover shows a hero-like figure with book-cover text.
results.outcome: FIXED - tablet now shows only the in-progress artwork (no toolbar/UI chrome); comic covers on shelf/desk show illustrated art only, no readable titles. Clean on both the text and screen-policy dimensions.

aggregate.fully_clean_cards: 4/8 (business.product_management, arts.voice_acting, arts.webcomics, and arts.hip_hop_dance on the text dimension specifically though it has a new brand finding)
